description_en: Retrieves the check results for data protection rules
description_zh: 查询数据保护规则检查结果
kebab_example: aliyun bdrc describe-check-details --resource-arn acs:ecs:123000890:cn-shanghai:instance/i-00100090 --rule-id rule-000000dav --next-token cae0000000000699 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCheckDetails

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the resource
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the data protection rule
parameters.help_zh: 数据保护规则唯一标识
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last API call. For more information about how to set this parameter, see the API description
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。有关本接口查看返回数据的设置方式，请参见上文接口说明
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results
